name: Special Meeting of the City Council - Closed Session
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council – CLOSED SESSION
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 11, 2023 - 5:00 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:

 Members of the public may join this meeting in-person in the Council Chambers. For Special
 Meetings, public communications are limited to agenda items. Written comments may be
 emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than 12:00 p.m. on the meeting
 date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the meeting and posted at
 https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 Once public comments are heard, the Closed Session will begin, and the meeting will be
 locked to unauthorized persons.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 5:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments on Closed Session Items only – may be
submitted electronically prior to the closed session starting. Members of the public may offer
comment in-person or via email as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. Live comments will be limited to three
minutes. Refer to Page 1 of the Agenda on how to submit your Public Comments electronically or
how to provide Live Public Comments.

CLOSED SESSION:

1.  Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation
  Significant Exposure to Litigation (California Government Code Section
  54956.9(d)(2)): 1 potential case.
  Facts and Circumstances: BKK Landfill

2.  Public Employee Performance Evaluation
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957(b)
  Title: City Manager

3.  Conference with Labor Negotiators
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager
  City Designated Representatives: Mayor Ray Pearl and Mayor Pro Tem Ned
  Davis

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, October 6, 2023 at 4:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
 www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the new Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a central
 location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications. Sign up using
 “Notify Me” https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours prior to the
 meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business hours and are posted on the
 City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets
